_note: Homepage collage (src/hero.js). One entry per photo slot. Put the image file in this folder and write its name in 'file'. 'alt' = what the photo shows, for screen readers. 'caption' = a short, TRUE description in capitals (e.g. INDEPENDENT RECORD STORE only if it is one); leave empty if unsure. 'credit' = photographer / account; 'source' = the page the photo comes from (the caption links to it). 'need' = what the slot is for (shown in the empty slot). 'focus' = which part of the photo stays in view when it is cropped to the slot (CSS object-position, e.g. '50% 40%'). Photos chosen 13 Oct 2026 from Lulu's Pinterest download (scraped/pinterest/Search/).
